name: What I Want From You
source:
A princess living in a tower, a dragon watching over her. But as in every fairy tale story, a prince arrives to disrupt daily life.

Prisoner of their desire, will they be able to get rid of their illusions before it is too late? The distortion of dream and reality taking place in a descent into hell. What is the true? What is a lie? What if your life is the lie?

[From [url=https://lea-rondeau.itch.io/what-i-want-from-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位公主住在塔里，一条龙守护着她。但正如每个童话故事中一样，王子的到来扰乱了日常生活。

被欲望囚禁的他们能否在为时已晚之前摆脱自己的幻想？梦境与现实的扭曲发生在坠入地狱的过程中。什么是真实的？什么是谎言？如果你的生活是谎言怎么办？

[来自[url=https://lea-rondeau.itch.io/what-i-want-from-you]Itch.io[/url]]
